description: List the plans this VPS can switch to IN PLACE with its data kept: bigger plans of the same network type (resize: more vCPU/RAM/disk), NAT → dedicated IPv4 (convert: adds a public IP) or dedicated → the equivalent NAT plan (convert_to_nat: drops the IP, the unused price difference is refunded to the balance). Each option: product_id, name, monthly, prorated_topup (charged now for the rest of the current period), mode. Shrinking vCPU/RAM/disk is not possible (a disk cannot be reduced). The server must be active. Requires: token, server active.

service_id.description: Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: get_upgrade_options
title: Plan change options
